Starting the Feed & Discovery Audit of bainluck.com. I'll systematically evaluate the home feed, category pages, navigation, and mobile experience, capturing screenshots and documenting all findings.

I have completed the comprehensive Feed & Discovery Audit for bainluck.com. 

The audit revealed several critical data quality issues, notably the 0% probability bug on golf cards, a squash player (Mostafa Asal) listed as the leader in a golf major, and the complete failure of the Golf Championship Grid page to load. The home feed also lacks crucial discovery features like sport filter pills and section headers. 

On the positive side, the category pages (Weather, Economics) and the MLB Championship Grid are exceptionally well-executed, offering rich data visualizations and clear probability indicators.

I have compiled the full findings, health score, and actionable recommendations into the attached Markdown report, along with relevant screenshots documenting both the successful pages and the critical failures.
